Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vinod - 35 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Anita - 25 years, daughter
Look: green saree
3. Shalini - 65 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Karan - 67 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
2. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
3. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Vinod stands on the road. Shalini and Karan stand near him.]

Shalini: "Let's do something fun today."

[Vinod starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Shalini: "Oh wow!"

[Vinod steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Vinod (laughing): "This is amazing!"

[Vinod's car crashes into a pole.]

Karan: "That's easy."

[Vinod loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Vinod (gently): "Exactly right."

[Vinod waits at the zebra crossing and then crosses the road.]

Vinod: "Well done!"

[Vinod honks at the traffic jam.]

Shalini: "Exactly right."

Scene 2: The kitchen - Day

Anita: "Let's begin."

[Anita rolls out rotis on the board.]

Anita: "Vinod, are you okay?"

[Anita stirs the dal in the pot.]

Anita (gently): "Okay, Mom."

Scene 3: The hospital ward - Day

[Vinod stands in the ward. Shalini and Karan stand near him.]

Vinod: "What a nice place."

[Mother passes away, and Vinod covers her body with a white sheet.]

Vinod: "No… this cannot be!"
